items.model_en: I eat breakfast with my family at seven.
items.model_zh: 我七點和家人一起吃早餐。
items.prompt_zh: 換成你自己的時間和對象，用 breakfast 造一個句子。
refs: I eat breakfast with my brother at six thirty.
My mother makes breakfast for me every day.

items.model_en: My father is busy on Monday mornings.
items.model_zh: 我爸爸星期一早上很忙。
items.prompt_zh: 想一個很忙的人或時間，用 busy 造句。
refs: My mother is busy in the kitchen every evening.
I am busy with my homework on Friday nights.

items.model_en: Mom is cooking noodles in the kitchen.
items.model_zh: 媽媽正在廚房煮麵。
items.prompt_zh: 用 kitchen 描述家裡有人在廚房做的事。
refs: Dad is washing the dishes in the kitchen.
There are many cups in our kitchen.

items.model_en: My brother is very tall.
items.model_zh: 我的哥哥非常高。
items.prompt_zh: 照這個句型（某人 + is/are + 形容詞），介紹你的家人或朋友。
refs: My sister is very cute.
My parents are very kind.

items.model_en: My mother cooks dinner for us every day.
items.model_zh: 我媽媽每天為我們煮晚餐。
items.prompt_zh: 照這個句型（第三人稱 + 動詞加s），寫一件家人每天做的事。
refs: My father drives me to school every morning.
My grandma waters the flowers every day.

items.model_en: The beef noodles at the night market are delicious.
items.model_zh: 夜市的牛肉麵很美味。
items.prompt_zh: 想一樣你最愛的食物，用 delicious 造句。
refs: The fried chicken at that stand is delicious.
My grandma's dumplings are delicious.

items.model_en: I order a bowl of rice and some soup.
items.model_zh: 我點了一碗飯和一些湯。
items.prompt_zh: 假裝你在餐廳，用 order 造一個點餐的句子。
refs: I order a hamburger and a cup of tea.
We order two bowls of noodles at the restaurant.

items.model_en: There is a famous restaurant near my school.
items.model_zh: 我學校附近有一間有名的餐廳。
items.prompt_zh: 用 restaurant 介紹一間你知道的餐廳在哪裡。
refs: There is a nice restaurant next to the park.
My family goes to a seafood restaurant on weekends.

items.model_en: Dad is making beef noodles in the kitchen.
items.model_zh: 爸爸正在廚房煮牛肉麵。
items.prompt_zh: 照這個句型（某人 + is/are + V-ing），寫一件「現在正在發生」的事。
refs: My sister is drinking bubble tea now.
The cook is making dumplings right now.

items.model_en: There are many restaurants near my home.
items.model_zh: 我家附近有很多餐廳。
items.prompt_zh: 用 There is 或 There are 描述你家附近有什麼。
refs: There is a breakfast shop near my home.
There are two night markets in my town.

items.model_en: We took a trip to Hualien last summer.
items.model_zh: 我們去年夏天去花蓮旅行。
items.prompt_zh: 想一次你去過的旅行，用 trip 造句（用過去式）。
refs: We took a trip to Tainan last month.
The trip to the beach was really fun.

items.model_en: It was sunny, so we went to the beach.
items.model_zh: 天氣晴朗，所以我們去了海邊。
items.prompt_zh: 用 sunny 寫一句話，說晴天時你做了或會做什麼。
refs: It was sunny yesterday, so we rode bikes in the park.
On sunny days, I like to swim with my friends.

items.model_en: We played in the water at the beach.
items.model_zh: 我們在海邊玩水。
items.prompt_zh: 用 beach 造一個關於海邊的句子。
refs: We built a sandcastle at the beach.
My family walked along the beach in the evening.

items.model_en: We visited Taroko Gorge last summer.
items.model_zh: 我們去年夏天遊覽了太魯閣。
items.prompt_zh: 照這個句型（主詞 + 動詞ed + 時間），寫一件過去做過的事。
refs: I stayed at my grandma's house last weekend.
We watched the sunset at the harbor yesterday.

items.target: 過去簡單式（不規則動詞）
items.model_en: We went to Kenting by train.
items.model_zh: 我們搭火車去墾丁。
items.prompt_zh: 用一個不規則動詞的過去式（went / saw / ate / bought…）造句。
refs: I ate mango ice with my cousin last night.
We saw many stars in the mountains.

items.model_en: I exercise in the park every morning.
items.model_zh: 我每天早上在公園運動。
items.prompt_zh: 用 exercise 寫一句你（或家人）的運動習慣。
refs: My father exercises at the gym twice a week.
I exercise with my dog in the evening.

items.model_en: She practices basketball after school.
items.model_zh: 她放學後練習籃球。
items.prompt_zh: 用 practice 寫一句你會練習的事情。
refs: I practice the piano for thirty minutes every day.
He practices English by singing songs.

items.model_en: Eating vegetables keeps us healthy.
items.model_zh: 吃蔬菜讓我們保持健康。
items.prompt_zh: 用 healthy 寫一句關於健康的建議或事實。
refs: Drinking water is good for a healthy body.
My grandpa is very healthy because he walks every day.

items.target: 未來式 will / be going to
items.model_en: We are going to play badminton tomorrow.
items.model_zh: 我們明天要去打羽球。
items.prompt_zh: 用 will 或 be going to 寫一件你之後打算做的事。
refs: I will swim with my friends this Saturday.
We are going to hike the mountain next week.

items.model_en: You should stretch before you run.
items.model_zh: 跑步前你應該先伸展。
items.prompt_zh: 用 can、must 或 should 寫一句運動或健康的建議。
refs: You should sleep eight hours every night.
We must warm up before swimming.

items.model_en: My classmate helps me with my math homework.
items.model_zh: 我的同學幫我做數學作業。
items.prompt_zh: 用 classmate 寫一句關於同學的事。
refs: My classmate and I eat lunch together every day.
One of my classmates is really good at drawing.

items.model_en: Our new teacher is friendly to everyone.
items.model_zh: 我們的新老師對每個人都很友善。
items.prompt_zh: 想一個友善的人，用 friendly 造句。
refs: The girl next door is friendly and always says hi.
My best friend is the most friendly person I know.

items.model_en: English is my favorite subject at school.
items.model_zh: 英文是我在學校最喜歡的科目。
items.prompt_zh: 用 subject 說說你最喜歡（或最不喜歡）的科目。
refs: Math is a difficult subject for me.
My favorite subject is PE because I love sports.

items.model_en: My best friend is taller than me.
items.model_zh: 我最好的朋友比我高。
items.prompt_zh: 照這個句型（A + 比較級 + than + B），比較兩個人或兩樣東西。
refs: My schoolbag is heavier than my sister's.
Summer vacation is longer than winter vacation.

items.model_en: Amy is the tallest student in our class.
items.model_zh: 艾咪是我們班最高的學生。
items.prompt_zh: 照這個句型（the + 最高級 + in/of…），寫一個「最…」的句子。
refs: My dad is the busiest person in my family.
This is the best book of the year.

items.model_en: I use the internet to learn English.
items.model_zh: 我用網路學英文。
items.prompt_zh: 用 internet 寫一句你如何使用網路。
refs: I use the internet to watch music videos.
My grandma uses the internet to chat with us.

items.model_en: Don't watch the screen for too long.
items.model_zh: 不要盯著螢幕太久。
items.prompt_zh: 用 screen 寫一句和 3C 螢幕有關的句子。
refs: My eyes hurt because I watched the screen all day.
You should look away from the screen every thirty minutes.

items.model_en: She sends me a message every night.
items.model_zh: 她每天晚上傳訊息給我。
items.prompt_zh: 用 message 造一個句子。
refs: I got a funny message from my cousin.
Please send me a message when you get home.

items.model_en: I usually watch videos after dinner.
items.model_zh: 我通常在晚餐後看影片。
items.prompt_zh: 用 always / usually / sometimes / never 寫一句你的習慣。
refs: I sometimes play online games with my friends.
He never uses his phone during dinner.

items.model_en: She likes this app because it is easy to use.
items.model_zh: 她喜歡這個 App，因為它很好用。
items.prompt_zh: 用 because 或 so 把兩個想法連起來造句。
refs: I like this game because I can play it with my friends.
My phone was broken, so I read a book instead.

items.model_en: Many birds live in the forest.
items.model_zh: 許多鳥住在森林裡。
items.prompt_zh: 用 forest 造一個關於森林的句子。
refs: We heard many insects in the forest at night.
The air in the forest is fresh and cool.

items.model_en: My little brother loves catching insects in summer.
items.model_zh: 我弟弟夏天最愛抓昆蟲。
items.prompt_zh: 用 insect 造句。
refs: There are many insects in the grass after the rain.
Some insects can make beautiful sounds at night.

items.model_en: We should protect the animals in the ocean.
items.model_zh: 我們應該保護海洋裡的動物。
items.prompt_zh: 用 protect 寫一句保護動物或環境的句子。
refs: We should protect the forest for the animals.
Sunglasses protect our eyes from the sun.

items.model_en: She enjoys watching birds in the park.
items.model_zh: 她喜歡在公園賞鳥。
items.prompt_zh: 用 enjoy + V-ing 或 want + to V 造一個句子。
refs: I enjoy swimming in the sea in summer.
We want to see the fireflies in the mountains.

items.model_en: We saw fireflies at night in the mountains.
items.model_zh: 我們晚上在山裡看到螢火蟲。
items.prompt_zh: 用 in、on、at 其中兩個，寫一句有時間或地點的句子。
refs: The cat sleeps on the sofa in the afternoon.
We watch stars at night in my grandpa's yard.

items.model_en: The train station is next to the department store.
items.model_zh: 火車站就在百貨公司旁邊。
items.prompt_zh: 用 station 描述某個車站的位置或你在車站做的事。
refs: I take the bus at the station near my home.
The MRT station is always full of people in the morning.

items.model_en: Living in the city is very convenient.
items.model_zh: 住在城市裡非常方便。
items.prompt_zh: 用 convenient 寫一句生活中方便的事。
refs: Convenience stores make our life convenient.
It is convenient to take the MRT to school.

items.model_en: I want to be a doctor in the future.
items.model_zh: 我未來想當醫生。
items.prompt_zh: 用 future 寫一句你對未來的想法。
refs: In the future, I want to travel around the world.
I will study harder for my future.

items.model_en: Where is the nearest convenience store?
items.model_zh: 最近的便利商店在哪裡？
items.prompt_zh: 用 What / Where / When / How 造一個問句。
refs: When does the new semester start?
How do you go to the library?

items.model_en: I have finished all my summer homework.
items.model_zh: 我已經完成所有暑假作業了。
items.prompt_zh: 用 have/has + p.p. 寫一件你已經完成或經歷過的事。
refs: I have read three books this summer.
She has visited Taipei 101 twice.
